problem.readBody: Check the connection and try again.
problem.suppressed: This address bounced or complained: correct it first.
problem.changed: Someone changed this meanwhile: we read it again.
problem.forbidden: Your role does not allow this.
problem.gone: This is not there any more: we read the tab again.
problem.invalid: Something here is not valid: check the fields.
problem.server: It did not go through: try again in a moment.

notice.mailFailed: The link was made but the e-mail to {email} did not go: send the questionnaire again.
notice.accepted_one: Answer accepted: its document is in force with its expiry.
notice.accepted_other: Answer accepted: its {count} documents are in force with their expiries.
notice.questions: Your questions are on the supplier's thread. Send a new link when it should answer again.
notice.published: Version {revision} of the questionnaire is published: links ask it from now on.

title: Supplier questionnaire
why: Due diligence for the Forced Labour Regulation (EU) 2024/3015 (applies from December 2027): the supplier answers by link, signs it, and you review it here. Each answer is kept as a PDF in the supplier's files.
noVersion: The company has no published questionnaire yet.

held.manage: Your role does not change the questionnaire (purchasing.questionnaire.manage).
held.draft: Version {revision} is a draft: publish it first.
held.send: Your role does not send the questionnaire (purchasing.questionnaire.send).
held.review: Your role does not review answers (purchasing.questionnaire.review).

send.title: Send the questionnaire to {name}
send.linkOnce: Copy it now and pass it on: it is shown only this once.
send.mailFailedBody: The link was made but not delivered: send the questionnaire again, or give the link by hand.
send.mailedBody: The link works until {day}. We tell you when the answer arrives.
send.withdrawn_one: The earlier open link was withdrawn.
send.withdrawn_other: The {count} earlier open links were withdrawn.
send.byMailBody: We send the link to a contact of the supplier.
send.byLinkBody: You get the link once and send it yourself (WhatsApp, your own e-mail).
send.emailHint: Kept with the link, so a new one can be asked for later.
send.language: Language of the page and the e-mail
send.noteHint: Shown on the page and in the e-mail.
send.replaces: An open link to this supplier is withdrawn when you send a new one.

answers.title: Answers
answers.waiting: No answer yet: the link is open.
answers.none: No answer yet. Send the questionnaire to ask for one.

file.failed: The file did not open: try again.

documents.title: Documents
documents.notReady: The file has not arrived or is being checked.

review.title: Review {name} · version {revision}
review.acceptBody_one: The answer is complete. Its document is put in force with its expiry date.
review.acceptBody_other: The answer is complete. Its {count} documents are put in force with their expiry dates.
review.questionsBody: Something is missing or unclear: your questions go on the supplier's thread; it answers again with a new link.
review.questionsHint: The supplier reads these words on its thread.
review.noteHint: For colleagues only: the supplier never sees it.

check.questions: Write the questions the supplier reads.
